visual_north_star: Editorial minimalism + technical instrumentation + premium enterprise software. Stop designing generic SaaS dashboards. The UI must feel desirable, powerful, fast, and calm under complexity.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium font-serif
hierarchy.h4: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-stone-500 font-sans
hierarchy.numbers: text-5xl to text-7xl for hero numbers, tabular-nums for datasets, confident scale.

rules: Typography is architecture: controlled scale, big confident numbers, quiet labels.
Never default chart-library styling; use bespoke, minimal-noise charts.
Warm off-white surfaces with very subtle cool-grey boundaries.
Restrained neon-lime highlights used like a laser pointer, only where I should look.
Brand marks (white) MUST sit on dark/near-black brand plates or dark olive surfaces.
No gradients, no glassmorphism, no giant shadows.

layouts.philosophy: Design according to the information, not a dashboard template. Break out of Sidebar->Header->KPIs.
patterns: Command Palette: Global search/actions accessible via keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K).
Bento/Asymmetric Grids: Intentional asymmetry with extremely clean alignment.
Split Views: Editorial presentation on one side, technical data canvas on the other.
Contextual Side Panels: Expand from source rather than blocking view entirely.
Spatial Maps: Data canvases for plot inventory rather than just tables.
layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace (p-8, p-12) coupled with dense technical clusters. Padding must prevent text collision.

signature_moments: Spatial Plot-Availability Map: An interactive canvas for Vacation Village and Central Vista Farms.
Maker-Checker Split View: Post Sales receipt on the left, Accounts verification pane on the right.
Procurement Pipeline: Timeline visualization showing Site Manager to Management to Admin to Accounts flow.
Dynamic KPI Canvas: Numbers that roll and transition when filters change.

motion.easing: ease-out for entrances, ease-in-out for transitions
rules: Communicate relationship, hierarchy, causality, and state.
Numbers roll, graphs interpolate, panels expand from source.

components.charts: Bespoke, minimal-noise with subtle axes, contextual annotations, and smooth transitions.
components.icons: Thin technical iconography (lucide-react with stroke-width 1 or 1.5).
components.cards: Subtle cool-grey boundaries (1px solid border), minimal or zero shadow. Flat, rectangular.
components.tables: Editorial density. No unnecessary vertical borders. Clear alignment (numbers right, text left).

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.contrast: Maintain high contrast for text (near-black on off-white). Neon-lime should be for accents, not text unless on very dark backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize UI layout construction before backend integrations.
Do NOT use a standard left-sidebar layout as the primary nav. Create a top-tier command centre or horizontal editorial navigation.
For the spatial plot view, consider using a custom HTML Canvas implementation with SVG plotting, or a highly customized grid.
Rely heavily on typography and spacing instead of boxes and borders.
Create a custom Shadcn theme utilizing the exact color variables.
Ensure the data-testid convention is applied meticulously.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or dropdowns.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth and editorial styling without relying on heavy shadows or neon gradients.
No universal transition (transition: all). Animate specific properties.
Do not center-align the main app container. Text needs a natural reading flow.
Use modern interaction styles (pill-shaped or sharp buttons).
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided ones.
Micro-animations are mandatory for interactive elements.
